summary: Matthew Johnston of Rico called 911 saying he was lost while hiking and thirsty near the West Fork overlook north of Pagosa Springs; deputies traced the call and found his vehicle at the overlook, but multi-county SAR teams found no trace and he remains missing.
location: West Fork of the San Juan overlook, U.S. Highway 160 north of Pagosa Springs
responding_agency: Mineral County Sheriff's Office; Archuleta County SAR; K-9 Search and Rescue of Dolores
notes: 911 call on Monday 2017-09-04; vehicle found by Mineral County SO at the overlook above the West Fork, just south of Wolf Creek Pass; search used people, dogs, helicopters, night vision; K-9 SAR of Dolores joined 2017-09-26 (response director Chuck Melvin); still missing - no indication of voluntary disappearance (family interviews). Incident facts verified from the article text by live browser 2026-09-18; DGO Magazine, 2020-10-21.
